title: Bounded modern civil-date/timezone and local mean solar hour bridge into original Zi Wei 14-principal-star positions

standard_time.birth_input: ISO YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS naive wall clock plus explicit IANA zone, exact fold and zero stated clock uncertainty
standard_time.zone_data_provenance: zoneinfo matched IANA zone, with exact TZIF binary SHA when filesystem backing exists
standard_time.dst_folds: requires explicit 0 or 1 when autumn local time is repeated
standard_time.official_modern_chinese_calendar_referen: fixed UTC+08:00; not historical Asia/Hong_Kong daylight civil time
calendar_day_choices: birthplace civil Gregorian date looked up using current HKO-derived lunar calendar algorithm
standard_time.normalization_problem: an outside-China birth UTC instant can map to a different reference Gregorian and lunar date depending explicitly selected convention

solar_hour.recorded_civil_clock: civil hour with any historical DST or law-shift already encoded in selected IANA zone
solar_hour.local_mean_solar_longitude: UTC instant plus 4 minutes per degree east longitude, not equation-of-time apparent Sun
solar_hour.longitude_source: explicit caller-supplied east-positive longitude; never inferred from IANA timezone

negative_or_variant_examples.status: nonexistent DST local time, always reject
nonexistent local date due dateline law change, always reject
